title: DeviceAuthorizationStartResponse
description: Response returned once when a device authorization starts. device_code is a secret and must never be logged, persisted in plaintext by the server, or shown to the user.

authorization_id.description: High-entropy public identifier used for status polling. It is not a credential.

device_code.description: One-time secret returned only by this response.

user_code.description: Short human-entered code with ambiguous characters removed.

verification_uri.description: Stable browser authorization entry point without credentials or query parameters. Production deployments must use https; http is reserved for loopback development.

verification_uri_complete.description: Browser entry point with the user code in the code query parameter. It must not contain credentials, fragments, or additional query parameters.
